_doc: Diarization accuracy corpus for `make diarize-eval` (Phase 1 gate). Audio stays LOCAL and is NOT committed; only this manifest, the RTTM truth, and diarization_baseline.json are. Each entry: name, audio (absolute, or relative to HEARSAY_OUTPUT_DIR / repo outputs/), channel (them = right channel of a stereo Hearsay audio.wav; mono = an already-mono clip such as AMI), expected_speakers (true remote-speaker count), and optional rttm (path relative to this crate, enables DER on top of the count check).
_ami_attribution: AMI Meeting Corpus meeting ES2004a, (c) University of Edinburgh, licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://groups.inf.ed.ac.uk/ami/corpus/). RTTM truth is pyannote/AMI-diarization-setup (only_words, test split; same 4-speaker truth for both conditions). Fetch the audio locally (not committed) with: curl -sSL http://groups.inf.ed.ac.uk/ami/AMICorpusMirror/amicorpus/ES2004a/audio/ES2004a.Mix-Headset.wav -o outputs/ami/ES2004a.Mix-Headset.wav ; curl -sSL http://groups.inf.ed.ac.uk/ami/AMICorpusMirror/amicorpus/ES2004a/audio/ES2004a.Array1-01.wav -o outputs/ami/ES2004a.Array1-01.wav
